ideas.summary: Buy-side SBA capital-stack structuring engine for self-funded ETA searchers, built around the post-June-2025 SOP 50-10 8 full-standby seller-note + 10% equity-injection rules.

cross.ai_signal: Frontier LLM reasoning (Claude Opus 4.8 / Gemini 3.5 agentic era) over dense, recently-rewritten SBA SOP rules + a buyer's messy deal inputs.
cross.structural_signal: SBA SOP 50-10 8 (effective 2025-06-01) tightened seller-note/equity rules so deals are 'falling through'; runs into the $5T baby-boomer small-business transfer driving record ETA deal volume.

ideas.buyer: First-time self-funded searcher / ETA buyer under signed LOI on a $400k-$2M SDE service business (HVAC, plumbing, landscaping), at the financing-structuring stage.
ideas.trigger: SOP 50-10 8 in force since 2025-06-01; the SBA lender rejects the assumed seller-note structure inside the 30-60 day diligence/financing window and the LOI clock is running.
ideas.why_incumbents_cant: Lender-side tools (Aloan, LenderAI, Biz2x, iBusiness) organize/underwrite the file to protect the bank AFTER structure is set; retained buy-side advisors (Munera) are uneconomic for sub-$2M deals; ETA content/communities educate but don't generate a compliant structure + seller-negotiation artifact.

ideas.summary: AI tribal-knowledge / founder's-brain capture to document a retiring SMB owner's operations before they leave.
ideas.kill_reason: Saturated (Context Memo, MO Docs AI, WorkCell, SimplySOPs, oxmaint, Cohevo) AND is essentially YC Summer-2026's own 'Company Brain' RFS. Textbook one-step extension of an AI trend; everyone has it simultaneously.

ideas.summary: Black-box algorithmic-discrimination audit for non-tech AI deployers (e.g. property managers, regional lenders) triggered by Colorado SB24-205.
ideas.kill_reason: The why-now trigger no longer exists: Colorado SB24-205 was repealed and replaced by SB 26-189 (signed 2026-05-14) and never took effect. No live mandate = no urgency. Killed on the facts.

ideas.summary: AI SBA 7(a) loan packaging / underwriting automation (lender-side analyst layer).
ideas.kill_reason: Saturated lender-side: Aloan, LenderAI (iBusiness Funding), Biz2x, CRS Credit API all do SOP-50-10-7/8 file organization and underwriting. Wrong side of the table from the unserved buyer.

ideas.summary: Agentic vendor-oversight tool that discovers an RIA's real vendor stack and enforces the Reg S-P 72-hour breach-notification clause, sold to PE-backed RIA aggregators.
ideas.kill_reason: Covered by RIA-vertical incumbents already owning the compliance relationship: Venminder, Ncontracts, Smart-RIA, itSynergy, AdvisorLaw. Agentic discovery is a feature, not a wedge against entrenched vendors. Reg S-P deadline (2026-06-03) is real but the space is taken.

ideas.summary: RIA client-repapering / advisor-transition automation for PE roll-ups, to stop AUM leakage during post-acquisition account migration.
ideas.kill_reason: Saturated: Feathery, TradePMR Fusion SYNC, Skience all lead with 'end manual repapering' and AI-assisted transitions; a 2026 platform comparison already exists. No opening.
